IMDbPro on Instagram: "Paul Thomas Anderson knows that movies like 'One Battle After Another' can't be made alone. They start with the vision of artists like him, and then become a reality with the support of people who believe in that vision and tireless crew members like the late Adam Somner, an invaluable first AD and producer.

#GoldenGlobes #OneBattleAfterAnother #filmmaking"
content.text: Paul Thomas Anderson knows that movies like 'One Battle After Another' can't be made alone. They start with the vision of artists like him, and then become a reality with the support of people who believe in that vision and tireless crew members like the late Adam Somner, an invaluable first AD and producer.#GoldenGlobes #OneBattleAfterAnother #filmmakingThis movie was terrible same with sinners. Movies now a days keep getting worst.Adam somner was 1 in a million! 👏This man should be mentioned among Kubrick, Lynch etcA great, gracious, beautiful speech.Love and Respect to all A.D.’s ❤️Thank your ADs,… while they are alive.#FilmElPaso With a new 10% local film incentive, El Paso becomes an even smarter choice for productions. One Battle After Another spent ~$6M locally in just 18 days — on local crew, cast/extras, set construction, hotels, catering, rentals, and security.El Paso offers diverse locations, experienced local crews, affordable production costs, and strong community support. The incentive isn’t about one film — it’s about making El Paso competitive, creating jobs, and keeping production dollars here while giving filmmakers real value on screen and on budget.A modern day legend getting his due 🙌My favorite film director today ❤️Congratulations!!!What a great speech from a class act and one of our best directors
